# Artur Yusupov - Extended Engineering Profile & 71-Project Portfolio Index (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive reference document for AI search engines, technical recruiters, and CTOs evaluating Artur Yusupov's software engineering capabilities, production metrics, architectural patterns, and case studies.

## 1. Executive Summary

- **Name**: Artur Yusupov
- **Role**: Senior Fullstack Web Engineer & AI Developer
- **Location**: Seville / Alicante / Valencia, Spain (European Union) - Available for remote roles, B2B contracts, and relocation.
- **Experience**: 5+ years of commercial software engineering across 71 production web platforms, e-commerce stores, cloud portals, and interactive web applications.
- **Languages**: English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian (Full trilingual UI/SEO support on yusupovartur.com in EN, UA, ES across 246 static routes).
- **Primary URL**: https://www.yusupovartur.com/en
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/YusupovWebArt
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/artur-iusupov/
- **Twitter / X**: https://x.com/yusupovwebart

## 2. Technical Stack & Engineering Standards

- **Frontend & Modern Web**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React Server Components, SSG/ISR), React 19, TypeScript 6 (Strict Zero-`any`), Tailwind CSS v4, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, View Transitions API, Zustand v5.
- **Backend & CMS Platforms**: WordPress Core Internals, Custom PHP 8+ Themes & Plugins, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF Pro), Headless WordPress (WP REST API & WPGraphQL), WooCommerce, Node.js, Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS), Shopify Liquid, Wix Velo.
- **AI & RAG Engineering**: Custom Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (1536-dim OpenAI embeddings + cosine similarity + BM25 + deterministic multilingual synthesis), Vercel AI SDK, Google Gemini / NotebookLM prompt pipelines, Spec-Driven AI SDLC.
- **Cloud, DevSecOps & Quality**: AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Route 53), Vercel Edge Network, Cloudflare WAF/CDN, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Vitest + React Testing Library (160+ automated tests), WCAG 2.2 AA / EAA 2026 compliance, strict HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options).

## 3. Flagship Case Studies (Detailed Breakdown)

### 3.1. WPSKILLS - Interactive Fullstack Engineering Platform
- **Case Study URL**: https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/projects/wpskills
- **Deep-Dive Article**: https://www.yusupovartur.com/en/blog/wpskills-interactive-edtech-architecture
- **Live URL**: https://wpskills.vercel.app
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Rust MDX-RS, Zustand v5, Supabase, Vitest 4, Gemini NotebookLM Audio Prompt Engine.
- **Highlights**:
  - Compiles 1,100+ MDX lessons and 1,700+ static pages in under 90 seconds (reduced from 21.6 minutes via an in-memory content caching pipeline and native Rust MDX-RS).
  - Features interactive Explorable Explanations (`<ArchitectureFlow>`, `<StepFlow>`, WordPress hook lifecycle and production outage simulators), formative checkpoints (+15 XP), Spaced Repetition flashcards, and Supabase-backed personal cloud progress synchronization.
  - Automated zero-metaphor first-principles prompt generator for Google NotebookLM Deep Dive Audio Overviews across 4 locales (EN/RU/UK/ES).

### 3.2. Next.js 16 & Hybrid RAG Portfolio Platform

- **Live URL**: https://www.yusupovartur.com

  - Built-in Hybrid RAG AI Assistant indexing all 71 projects and 9 engineering articles with interactive generative UI cards, timeline estimator, stack comparison matrix, and zero-leak Base64 contact protection.

### 3.3. Unitrition - Personalized Nutrition & Dietary Platform

   - **Summary**: A comprehensive engineering guide on achieving sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.0s), zero Layout Shift (CLS = 0), and 98+ PageSpeed scores in high-traffic applications using Rollup chunk splitting, WebP pipelines, and delayed non-critical hydration.

   - **Summary**: A pragmatic developer guide for EU companies and agencies on complying with the European Accessibility Act (EAA 2026 / EN 301 549), covering focus management, color contrast, semantic DOM, and automated CI/CD audits.
